Class SwitcherDef.View

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.SwitcherDef.View
All Implemented Interfaces:
Handled<SwitcherDef.View>
Enclosing class:
SwitcherDef
public static final class SwitcherDef.View extends Object implements Handled<SwitcherDef.View>
One view of a switcher.

Example:

v.section("all", "All", card).initialSection("all").on("activated", "orders.shown");
